jobs.title: Principal, Enterprise Implementation
jobs.description:
**Principal, Enterprise Implementation**

  

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers.

The Principal, Enterprise Implementation is the single accountable owner, and the hands-on operator, of Fullbay’s largest implementations, from pre-sale scoping through a stable go-live. These are multi-entity, multi-brand projects with significant technical, data, and project management interlock with senior customer executives. The Principal runs these projects personally rather than directing others to run them, but does not do it alone. The role leads a small direct team (Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer and Project Manager), works with Data Services as a shared service, and holds written decision rights over data queue priority, cutover go/no-go, scope changes and the configuration baseline. The role also sets the enterprise standards that high-volume onboarding, which runs as a separate motion, inherits.

Reporting to the CCO, this role partners with Customer Success (commercial and executive relationship), Product and Engineering (platform constraints and fixes), Sales (deal-time scoping), Data Services, Finance, and Support. The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility in data migration and integrations, the program rigor to run several concurrent cutovers, and the executive presence to be a credible peer to a customer’s CIO and hold them through a hard cutover.

**The Right Wrench for the Job**

In a heavy-duty shop, the biggest, most complicated job doesn’t go to whoever happens to be free. It goes to the master tech who has rebuilt that system before, knows which bolt will fight back, and keeps the customer informed long before the truck leaves the bay. That is this role. You take Fullbay’s largest and most complex implementations and run them with your own hands, from the first scoping conversation through a stable go-live, with the technical depth to see what will go wrong before it does.

You’re the right fit if you have personally run complex data migrations and cutovers, not just managed them, and you can hold your ground with a customer’s CIO when a cutover gets hard. You bring the rigor to run several go-lives at once through clear gates, the honesty to report status as it really is, and the judgment to take the hardest work yourself. You also leave things better than you found them, with the playbooks, decision rights and standards that make the next implementation easier. If you want to own the biggest builds and build the team that will own them next, we’d like to talk.

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Personally run every large implementation end to end: plan, gates, risk, customer readiness, cutover and post-go-live stabilization. Serve as the single accountable owner and day-to-day operator on each engagement, with a named customer counterpart.
* Hold written decision rights over data queue priority across accounts, the go/no-go recommendation for each cutover, scope changes and change orders, the configuration baseline and decision log, and feasibility calls against the platform.
* Lead the direct team (Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer and Project Manager) and work with Data Services on each engagement: work alongside them, set dates and escalate conflicts to the CCO. Take the highest-risk work directly rather than delegating it.
* Maintain a single source of truth for gate status, so customer-facing boards, internal plans and data queues agree before any commitment is made.
* Define and enforce the data accountability model: what migrates, what has a workaround, who at Fullbay owns each data element, who at the customer validates it, and which gate it sits under.
* Set the standard for Core 4 data (customers, units, vendors, inventory) and associated elements: customer-approved files and settled metadata before any import, so rework after import is the exception.
* Own the configuration baseline across multi-entity instances (settings, permissions, rates, tax and mapping) and the release process that keeps instances consistent.
* Own cutover strategy: data flash timing, soft launch versus hard cutover, parallel-system exposure, reconciliation and invoice parity testing.
* Lead integration planning with customers (accounting, payments, ERP and HR systems, telematics), including ownership and dependencies for each component.
* Assess migration feasibility and throughput against platform limits. Partner with Product and Engineering to resolve blockers such as import speed, performance and requirements the product cannot yet meet, and set customer expectations accordingly.
* Run concurrent cutovers through a defined stage-gate model with explicit entry and exit criteria, and report engagement health (RAG) to executives in a way that reflects technical risk, not only task completion.
* Own scoping and change control for enterprise engagements: effort estimation, statements of work, change orders and review before commitments are made, working with Sales and Finance.
* Maintain the RAID log and decision log for each engagement, and run a standing cross-account sequencing review with Data Services.
* Build the enterprise implementation playbook, templates and tooling, and capture process knowledge now held by individual team members so it is documented and transferable.
* Act as the technical counterpart to customer executives and technical leaders: lead steering reviews, hold them through hard decisions, defend the plan and escalate early.
* Partner with the account owner in Customer Success so the technical relationship through go-live and the commercial relationship stay aligned, and co-own the customer outcome at each gate.
* Define the post-go-live stabilization gate (for example, issue volume below an agreed threshold for a set period) and hand off day-to-day management to Customer Success cleanly.
* Define the line between enterprise engagements and run-rate onboarding, and set the handoff standard with the onboarding team.
* Hire, develop and manage the direct team (TAM, SE, PM): set expectations, assess capability and fit, and recommend staffing and role changes to the CCO.
* Grow the team deliberately: define roles, capacity model and hiring profile as engagement volume grows, and recommend when to add capacity or specialization.
* Feed lessons from enterprise engagements into onboarding standards so they become repeatable practice for high-volume implementations.
* Be the voice of enterprise delivery in Product, Engineering and Support planning, escalating platform gaps with evidence (volumes, durations, customer impact).
* Partner with Sales on deal-time scoping for enterprise opportunities so commitments match deliverable scope and capacity.
* Work with Finance on engagement economics, capacity planning and any billable services scope.
* Work with Support and Tier 3 on escalation paths for large customers during and after cutover.
* Success is measured by on-time, on-scope go-lives with an approved gate record for every cutover; less rework after data import and fewer post-go-live configuration corrections; post-go-live stability, with issue volume and escalations trending down within the stabilization period; customer confidence, with executive sponsors agreeing to the next phase and delivery-dependent expansion realized; and delivery decisions made within the role, with escalation to the CCO by exception.

  

**Additional Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Adhere to all confidentiality and compliance regulations
* Perform other duties as assigned

  

**Minimum Education & Work Experience:**

* 5+ years leading complex enterprise software implementations, including data migrations, in B2B SaaS or a comparable technical environment. Recent experience with multi-entity or multi-brand consolidations is strongly preferred.
* Experience in a PE-backed or investor-reported environment is a plus.
* Experience in heavy-duty repair, fleet maintenance or commercial vehicle industries, or in vertical SaaS for operations-heavy businesses, is a plus.

  

**Key Skills and Qualifications:**

* Hands-on technical depth: has personally run complex data migrations and cutovers, not only managed them, with working knowledge of data migration (extract, transform, load, reconciliation), integrations (accounting, payments, ERP) and configuration architecture, sufficient to be credible with a data engineering team and to challenge feasibility and estimates.
* Program rigor: a proven record running multiple concurrent, high-stakes cutovers through stage gates, with disciplined risk management and honest status reporting.
* Executive presence: a credible peer to customer CIOs, CFOs and operations leaders, able to lead steering reviews and hold them through difficult cutover decisions.
* Range and leadership: has led both complex enterprise engagements and higher-volume implementation or onboarding operations, can set standards for both, and has managed a small delivery team while remaining a hands-on operator.
* Experience establishing decision rights, gates and playbooks where none existed, and influencing without direct authority across Product, Engineering, Support, Sales and Customer Success.
* Experience with scoping, statements of work and change control for enterprise engagements.
* Familiarity with project and customer-facing delivery tooling such as Monday.com, Salesforce and ChurnZero, or equivalents.

  

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
* Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
* Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
* Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
* Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.

**Job Profile**

**Position Overview**
=====================

Founded in 1987, Tempus Technologies is the expert leader of secure payments at the point of interaction. We're committed to developing exceptional point-of-sale payment integration technology and software solutions to meet the growing needs of our customers' business requirements. As a leader in the industry, we recognize our employees as one of our greatest assets. Tempus is growing and our team is growing with us, allowing for unlimited possibilities for career advancement and the potential for employees to develop their own individual career paths.
  
  
As a Implementation Lead within Tempus Technologies, subsidiary of PNC, you will be based remotely.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a highly experienced implementation professional with strong product and technical knowledge, exceptional customer support skills, and the ability to take on leadership responsibilities across the team. This individual will lead our most complex implementations and enterprise merchant engagements, serving as a trusted technical resource for customers, teammates, and internal partners. We are looking for someone who can troubleshoot complex issues, confidently navigate escalations, and help drive challenging projects forward. Just as importantly, this person should be passionate about developing others through mentoring, training, documentation, and knowledge sharing, helping build the team’s overall technical knowledge and ensure others are prepared to provide the same high level of support.  
This position may be eligible for remote work in select geographic locations, subject to approval by PNC. If approved, work must be conducted from a quiet, secure, and confidential home-based workspace. Occasional in-office participation may be required based on business needs.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

**Job Description**
===================

* Responsible for developing customized implementation plans for clients. Directs required internal service partners to ensure delivery of service is completed within agreed upon timeframes, with full ownership of end-to-end process.
* Conduct implementation kickoff with client (in-person or via teleconference) to review project requirements, develop plan of approach, develop customized implementation project plan, directs group of internal resources, assigns roles and responsibilities and determine agreed upon timeframes for completion; regular communication with client and sales to update status and address issues.
* Manage each implementation as a project from end to end while meeting defined SLAs with a focus on expediting revenue generation.
* Regular communication with client and PNC sales officers to update status and address issues and to support sales efforts.
* Lead training sessions with client as needed via webinars, on phone, and in person for one/one interaction on more complex implementations.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

* **Customer Focused** - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
* **Managing Risk** - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

--------------------

Analytical Thinking, Change Management, Customer Solutions, Data Analytics, Financial Processes, Organizational Analysis, Storytelling, Waterfall Model

**Competencies**
----------------

Accuracy and Attention to Detail, Application Delivery Process, Consulting, Effective Communications, Knowledge Of Product Line, Managing Multiple Priorities, Operational Functions, Problem Management Process, Standard Operating Procedures

In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

------------------------

Your primary focus is translating new product features, service models, and business processes into scalable AI workflows and frontline operational procedures. You will be held accountable for measures of success, including implementation velocity, agent adoption rates, and overall process efficiency. This role is fully remote in New York.

**Your role:**

* Manage end-to-end change management, leveraging frontline feedback loops to refine workflows, mitigate risks, and drive operational readiness.
* Establish and maintain single-source-of-truth documentation, SOPs, Knowledge Base articles, and reference guides across all program phases.

* Team player with a proactive, self-starting approach and a continuous learning mindset.
* Calm, reliable, and solution-oriented under pressure, with a natural drive to improve processes and enable operational excellence

* We Raise the Bar
* We Keep It Simple
* We Build A Legacy
* We Care

* An inclusive company culture where you can bring your authentic self to work
* A strong, values-driven team culture where we celebrate successes and socialise with colleagues that care to offer

jobs.title: Fractional Implementation Project Specialist
jobs.description:
**ABOUT FORJ**

Forj is a single solution for community and learning, purpose-built to modernize the member experience for associations and professional networks — serving over 300 organizations and a million professionals who rely on us to connect, learn, and grow. We’re a remote-first company headquartered in Delafield, Wisconsin, united not by a shared office but by a shared belief that the professionals who make our world better deserve better. We forge ahead with boldness and determination, but we know great work comes from people who feel trusted and supported — flexibility isn’t a perk here, it’s how we operate. Our five core values — ***We Forge Ahead, We Innovate, We Build Relationships, We Learn and Grow Always, We Win Together*** — aren’t just words; they’re how we show up for each other every day. We care about you as a person, not just a professional. We laugh, we celebrate, and we have each other’s backs. If you’re driven by meaningful work and a team that’s genuinely in it together, you belong here.

**ABOUT THE ENGAGEMENT**

Forj is seeking an experienced Implementation Project Specialist to provide fractional project coordination support for our client implementations. Our clients are launching Forj Connect, Forj Learn and Journey by Forj, often while migrating from other platforms and connecting to their association management systems (AMS). You will keep implementations organized and moving by maintaining project plans, documenting client meetings, tracking action items and following up so nothing falls through the cracks. You’ll collaborate with our Implementation Specialists, who lead configuration, integrations and client delivery, and our Client Success Managers, who own client strategy and the relationship.

**HOW THIS ENGAGEMENT WORKS**

This is a fractional contract engagement estimated at **15 to 20 hours per week**. You decide when, where and how you work. The one exception is scheduled client calls and internal project meetings, which take priority: we expect you to attend them reliably and plan the rest of your work around them. Beyond those commitments, success is measured by delivering the services and outcomes in this scope of work, not by when you’re online or what hours you keep. Response times and communication norms will be agreed on at the start of the engagement so clients and the Forj team always know what to expect.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Set up and maintain implementation project plans in Planhat, and keep dates and tasks current as changes are confirmed with the Implementation Specialist
* Schedule client meetings, prepare agendas from open action items, document notes, and deliver a written recap within 24 hours covering decisions, actions, owners and dates
* Maintain risk, decision and change request logs, and promptly flag potential delays or new client requests to the Implementation Specialist
* Track progress toward project milestones (kickoff, plan approval, configuration sign-off, migration sign-off, user acceptance testing and go-live), and collect required approvals and documentation
* Follow up with clients on outstanding items such as data exports, single sign-on (SSO) setup, DNS changes and access to client technical contacts
* Track cross-functional tasks across Implementation, Product, Engineering, Training and Client Success, send reminders ahead of due dates, and raise blockers with the Implementation Specialist or Director of Client Operations
* Prepare launch and handoff documentation for the Client Success Manager, including open issues, decisions and project records
* Recommend improvements to implementation templates, checklists and automation, including AI-assisted call recaps and status reporting

  

**EXPECTED OUTCOMES**

*Success in this engagement is measured by the outcomes below*

  

* Supporting 2–3 active implementations within the first 30 days, and a full coordination workload by month three
* Reliable attendance at scheduled client calls and internal project meetings
* Accurate, current project plans and logs in Planhat, with recaps delivered within 24 hours of every client call
* Consistent tracking and follow-up on client action items, reducing delays caused by missed or forgotten tasks
* Reduced scheduling, documentation and follow-up load on Implementation Specialists
* Practical recommendations for improving templates, checklists and handoff documentation

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

  

* **Highly organized:** you keep many moving parts tracked and up to date
* **Detail-oriented:** you catch missed dates, open items and inconsistencies before they become problems
* **Self-directed:** you manage your own time and deliver reliably without close oversight
* **Clear communicator:** your recaps and reminders are concise, accurate and easy to act on
* **Curious about technology:** you don’t need to write code, but you have a working knowledge of how SSO, migrations and integrations work and can quickly get up to speed on new systems.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3-5 years of experience in project coordination, implementation, onboarding or operations support, ideally in a SaaS environment
* Experience tracking tasks, timelines and action items across multiple projects at once
* Strong written communication, including meeting notes, recaps and status updates
* Comfortable with project and customer success tools (e.g., Planhat or similar, Jira, HubSpot, Zoom)
* Familiarity with SSO, data migrations or system integrations is beneficial
* Experience with association, nonprofit or membership organizations, AMS platforms (e.g., iMIS, NetForum, Fonteva, Nimble), or community and learning (LMS) platforms is beneficial
* Proficiency using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to work more efficiently, with good judgment in reviewing and owning AI-generated content
* CAPM or similar project coordination certification is beneficial

  

**ENGAGEMENT REQUIREMENTS**

* Operates as an independent business or sole proprietor and provides a W-9
* Legally able to provide services in the United States
* Provides own computer, internet access and workspace
* Able to collaborate with a distributed team across time zones
* Able to sign Forj’s independent contractor agreement, including confidentiality and data protection terms

jobs.title: AI Strategy and Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Scope**

AI Strategy & Opportunity Identification

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI across departments to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and increase revenue.
* Work with department leaders to understand business processes, challenges, and potential AI applications.
* Evaluate and prioritize AI initiatives based on business impact, feasibility, cost, and ROI.
* Help develop and maintain the company's AI roadmap.

AI Team Development

* Assist leadership in defining the structure, roles, and capabilities needed for an internal AI team.
* Identify technical skills, resources, and external partners required to execute AI initiatives.
* Help establish processes for evaluating, approving, and implementing AI projects.
* Support the development of company-wide AI standards, governance, and best practices.

AI Project Execution

* Translate business needs into clear AI project requirements and functional specifications.
* Coordinate between department stakeholders, IT, developers, and external AI vendors.
* Manage AI project priorities, timelines, deliverables, and implementation progress.
* Evaluate AI tools, platforms, and automation solutions, including build-versus-buy decisions.
* Coordinate pilot programs and proof-of-concept testing before broader deployment.

Business Process Improvement & Automation

* Analyze existing workflows to identify opportunities for AI-driven automation.
* Develop process documentation, workflow maps, and implementation requirements.
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI with existing business systems, databases, and reporting tools.
* Help standardize and improve processes before implementing AI solutions.

Performance Measurement & Adoption

* Establish KPIs and success criteria for AI initiatives, including productivity gains, cost savings, and ROI.
* Monitor implemented solutions to ensure they deliver measurable business value.
* Work with department leaders to drive AI adoption and employee training.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful AI applications across the organization.
* Provide regular updates to leadership on AI initiatives, results, and recommended next steps.

AI Governance & Risk Management

* Support the development of policies governing responsible AI use, data security, and confidentiality.
* Evaluate potential risks associated with AI tools, vendors, and business applications.
* Ensure appropriate human oversight, testing, and quality controls are incorporated into AI-enabled processes.

===================================================================

**Skills & Experience**

AI Knowledge & Technical Competency

* Strong understanding of generative AI, large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and workflow automation.
* Hands-on experience with AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or Gemini.

jobs.title: Commercial Implementation Lead
jobs.description:
**About Us**

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick-care" to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against "we caught it too late again".

The Commercial Implementation Lead is the connective tissue between Sales and the rest of the business for B2B contracts across Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnerships. This role owns cross-functional alignment on what Prenuvo commits to in a contract and when we can deliver it — partnering with sales leaders to pressure-test any obligations that require Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales Ops, Marketing, and Legal before signature, then converting signed terms into a sequenced launch plan and driving it to go-live and beyond.

This is an operational partnership role. The Commercial Implementation Lead works shoulder-to-shoulder with sales leadership, and Account Managers as their operational counterpart: the person who tells them what is deliverable, on what timeline, at what cost, and who then makes it happen. This role does not source or close new business; it exists to make sure what we sign is achievable, implemented well, stays compliant, and performs.

**This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).**

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people's lives!

**What You'll Do**

### **Cross-Functional Alignment on Commitments**

* Serve as the single point of accountability for cross-functional alignment on contractual commitments — what Prenuvo agrees to deliver, by when, and at what operational cost — across Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnerships.
* Partner with Sales during deal construction to pressure-test new proposed terms against operational reality, convening Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales Ops, Legal, and Marketing to confirm feasibility, sequencing, and delivery timelines before commitments are made.
* Translate business asks from Sales into clear requirements for internal teams, and translate internal constraints back into terms Sales can negotiate with confidence.
* Escalate and resolve conflicts between what a deal requires and what the business can support, driving to a documented decision rather than an open question.
* Maintain a shared record of standard versus non-standard commitments, so repeat asks are answered consistently and quickly and one-off exceptions are visible and deliberate.

### **Implementation and Launch Execution**

* Own post-sale implementation for all executed contracts from signature through go-live, receiving handoff from Sales and channel leaders and converting contract terms into an operational launch plan with named owners and dates.
* Lead launches across all three channels, coordinating Marketing, Sales Ops, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and external stakeholders against a shared timeline.
* Partner with Finance and Sales Ops on the operational mechanics of each contract — billing and invoicing setup, pricing and discount structures, revenue recognition inputs, quota and crediting implications, and reporting requirements.
* Partner with Product and Engineering where contracts require configuration, integration, data exchange, or roadmap-dependent deliverables; hold the line on what is committed versus what is aspirational.
* Ensure compliance with all contractual, marketing, clinical, and operational deliverables across each channel, and track obligations through their full lifecycle.

### **Operational Partnership to Sales**

* Act as the operational partner to sales leaders and Account Managers, providing visibility into implementation status, delivery risk, and what can realistically be promised to accounts in flight.
* Participate in pipeline and account reviews to flag downstream operational implications early and keep commercial and delivery expectations aligned.
* Equip Account Managers with the operational detail they need for renewal, expansion, and escalation conversations.

### **Systems, Data, and Performance**

* Develop and manage centralized tracking of contacts in Salesforce, contract terms, engagement metrics, content performance, and preferences across Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnerships.
* Monitor implementation and post-launch performance metrics by channel, and translate insights into actions that drive account and partnership growth.
* Build the reporting and dashboards that give Sales, Finance, and leadership a shared view of commitments outstanding, launches in flight, and delivery risk.

### **Relationship Management and Retention**

* Uphold strong company representation and retain relationships with external partners post-launch to drive continued growth and long-term success (where applicable).
* Track account and partner satisfaction, proactively surfacing and addressing risks to ensure long-term retention across all channels.
* Develop and sustain strong relationships through consistent, high-touch engagement and professionalism, tailored to the distinct dynamics of Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnership relationships.
* Maintain confidentiality and HIPAA compliance when interacting with physicians, enterprise clients, and partners.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5–8 years in implementation, onboarding, deal desk, contract operations, revenue operations, or partner/account management, ideally spanning more than one type of commercial relationship (transactional and partnership-based).
* Demonstrated track record of driving cross-functional alignment without direct authority — bringing Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales Ops, Legal, and Marketing to a shared decision on scope and timing, and holding them to it.
* Experience acting as the operational counterpart to a sales organization, partnering directly with sales leaders and Account Managers on what can be committed and delivered.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience is required, including building and maintaining reports, dashboards, and custom tracking structures; experience partnering with Sales Ops on CRM design and data integrity strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to read and operationalize contract terms accurately without formal legal training.
* Working fluency with the commercial mechanics of a deal — pricing and discounting, billing and invoicing, revenue recognition implications — sufficient to partner credibly with Finance.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent launches with competing timelines and varying complexity across different stakeholder types.
* Comfort translating between commercial and technical audiences, including scoping product or engineering dependencies with enough precision to set a realistic delivery date.
* Healthcare, diagnostics, or other regulated-industry experience strongly preferred.
* Ability to shift tone and approach across distinct relationship types: clinical/physician, enterprise procurement, and strategic partners.

**Our Values**

First: we are **Pioneers**

* Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are **Platform-Builders**

* We're always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what's ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are **Patients**

* We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients' lives, and we won't stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

**What We Offer**

* An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
* We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
* Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we're doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
* Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
* Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
* We now offer the Prenuvo's Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Whether you ride, drive, or park, we've got you covered—making your commute easier and more affordable!
* Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
* We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
* **The base salary for this role ranges from $102,000-$120,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location**

*We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

*As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.*

**Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain [****prenuvo.com****]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.**

Pathways 2 Solutions, Inc. (Pathways) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business helping government and commercial clients turn complex challenges into practical solutions. **Position Overview**
=====================

Working under the direction of the assigned Pod Lead or Implementation Lead, the Specialist provides hands-on research, analysis, coordination, and implementation support across concurrent DRHCI initiatives. The Innovation and Implementation Specialist carries the business case for each assigned project from its start to its transition. At the front end, market research that validates the problem and establishes the project charter; at the back end, develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard, updated market research, analysis of alternatives, and budget estimates that a project needs to transition to the Digital Health Office for enterprise scaling.  
The role contributes throughout the innovation lifecycle from understanding the problem and assessing local readiness to supporting pilots, gathering feedback, refining implementation approaches, and preparing resources for continued use. The Specialist applies sound judgment to assess information, identify gaps, and recommend practical solutions appropriate to the intended users and implementation setting.  
For assigned business-process activities, the Specialist carries forward the evidence and assumptions supporting a project’s business case from initial problem validation through pilot results and consideration for enterprise scaling. The role coordinates market research, project charters, value scorecards, and resource estimates, drawing on the data and evaluation team for measurement methodology and validated outcome data.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Supports market research for assigned projects, partnering with innovators to complete the Market Research Guide validating the problem, quantifying scope and impact, and assessing the market landscape to determine best value for VA.

* Develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard for assigned projects transitioning to DHO, including measured impact against baseline and validated cost savings and ROI supported by evidence.
* Summarizes lessons learned, changes to assumptions, and unintended consequences for assigned projects.
* Socializes the business case with DHO and relevant local and national parties, gathering feedback and adapting scope as necessary.
* Updates market research to account for new analyses of alternatives and projected demand within VA as a project matures.
* Reassesses resource and funding needs for scaling, including additional costs for communications, training, and evaluation support, and produces budget estimate reporting.
* Contributes to the shared tracking system with DHO monitoring projects in transition and those accepted into the scaling pipeline.
* Works with the Data & Evaluation Lead to ensure the metrics and baselines committed at charter are the ones the business case will need at the end. Supports coordination meetings with DHO and relevant program offices to review scaling pipeline candidates and align priorities.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================

This position has no formal supervisory responsibility. The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned work, collaborate effectively, maintain accurate status information, and communicate barriers early.  
The role may coordinate working sessions and contributions from multiple stakeholders. Decisions involving clinical practice, technology configuration, security authorization, procurement, resource commitments, or changes in scope are elevated to the appropriate authorized personnel.  
For business-process assignments, the Specialist works with the assigned innovation pod lead and designated data and evaluation personnel to maintain consistency between project assumptions, measurement methods, validated results, and scaling recommendations. Approval of project charters, funding commitments, procurement approaches, and enterprise scaling remains with authorized personnel.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Five or more years in business analysis, program analysis, or management consulting involving business case development.
* Demonstrated experience conducting market research or analysis of alternatives to support a build, buy, or reuse decision.
* Experience developing a business case with cost and benefit analysis that a skeptical reviewer accepted.
* Experience producing project charters and structuring project scope, roles, and responsibilities.
* Ability to work with quantitative evaluation data without owning the analysis, and to represent it honestly including its limits.
* Strong written communication for executive audiences.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools, including Microsoft Teams and SharePoint, and the ability to learn required tracking and reporting platforms.
* Ability to obtain a VA background investigation or public trust determination.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting digital health, telehealth, remote patient monitoring, connected devices, or other healthcare innovations.
* Experience supporting pilot programs, site-readiness assessments, workflow improvement, or multisite implementation.
* Familiarity with implementation science, human-centered design, change management, or continuous quality improvement methods.
* Experience developing implementation toolkits, process guides, readiness checklists, or sustainment resources.
* Experience engaging clinicians, operational staff, Veterans, caregivers, or other healthcare stakeholders.
* Familiarity with barriers affecting rural populations, people with disabilities, or users with varying levels of digital literacy.
* Experience working within agile, sprint-based, or multidisciplinary project teams.
* Experience supporting VA, other federal healthcare organizations, or Veteran-facing programs.

**Credentials and VA Experience**
=================================

No professional certification or prior VA experience is required.  
Relevant training or certification in implementation science, project management, change management, human-centered design, Lean Six Sigma, or quality improvement is preferred.

**Performance Expectations**
============================

Successful performance is demonstrated through:

* Accurate research and useful, well-supported recommendations.
* Timely completion of assigned implementation activities and resources.
* Early identification and escalation of readiness gaps and delivery barriers.
* Effective coordination with participating sites and interdisciplinary contributors.

The Senior Consultant, Equity Administration & Financial Reconciliation is a highly skilled, detail-oriented equity and financial reporting professional within insightsoftware’s Professional Services organization. This role is crucial to ensuring the accurate reconciliation of both financial reporting data for equity compensation and administrative equity data as customers migrate from their current equity management platform to the NextGen platform.

On the financial side, you will own the reconciliation of ASC 718 stock compensation expense, corporate tax, disclosures, and ASC 260 diluted EPS. On the administrative side, you will reconcile participant- and grant-level equity data — balances, lifecycle events, and transaction history — between the legacy platform and NextGen. Across both, you will develop and deliver comparison reports, analyze discrepancies, and produce comprehensive reconciliation documentation. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who takes initiative, thinks critically, and operates effectively across systems and teams with minimal oversight. You will be a senior point of contact on assigned workstreams, partner directly with customer stakeholders, and lead by example — mentoring more junior contributors and reliably delivering the most complex, high-stakes work.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

**Financial Reconciliation**
----------------------------

* Reconcile equity compensation financial reporting results between the customer’s prior results and NextGen, spanning ASC 718 stock compensation expense, corporate and deferred tax, disclosures, and ASC 260 diluted EPS.
* Develop and deliver comparison reports for each reconciliation cycle, including summary and detailed analysis of differences.
* Analyze comparison reports to identify and quantify calculation differences, determine root causes, and recommend resolutions.
* Provide clear reconciliation documentation that helps customers understand the differences, if any, between NextGen’s calculations and their previous methods.
* Apply a working knowledge of how fair values, accounting setup selections, and migrated data drive these outputs — other teams perform configuration and data loading — so differences can be explained and resolved.

**Administrative Reconciliation**
---------------------------------

* Reconcile participant- and grant-level equity data — grants, vesting schedules, exercises, releases, cancellations, forfeitures, and outstanding/exercisable balances — between the legacy platform and NextGen.
* Validate share balances and grant lifecycle events to confirm transaction history migrated completely and accurately.
* Reconcile ESPP enrollment, contribution, and purchase data, and confirm participant demographic, tax, and account information transferred correctly.
* Identify, quantify, and document administrative discrepancies and deltas, performing root-cause analysis and driving items to resolution.
* Produce administrative reconciliation comparison reports and maintain follow-up trackers of open items through closure.
* Partner with the financial reconciliation workstream to ensure administrative data ties back to expense, tax, disclosure, and EPS results.

**Cross-Functional Dependencies & Systems Thinking**
----------------------------------------------------

* Understand how the work of adjacent teams flows together — the team loading customer data, the product team building and evolving the NextGen platform, and the administrative and financial reconciliation workstreams — and how each affects your deliverables.
* Anticipate how data loading, system configuration, and platform changes impact reconciliation results and report accuracy, and coordinate proactively to unblock and align.
* Validate migrated and loaded data against expected results, surface discrepancies to the responsible team, and confirm fixes flow through correctly — without owning the loading or configuration itself.
* Document mapping logic, exceptions, and resolution steps to maintain a clear, auditable trail across teams.

* Strong working knowledge of ASC 718 expense reporting, ASC 260 diluted EPS, corporate tax, and disclosure concepts, with the ability to apply them to reconciliations and report building (other teams own system configuration and data loading).

* **Initiative & Strong Ownership:** takes responsibility for outcomes end to end and drives work forward without needing to be managed.
